capabilities: Create project files from empty image embed links
Open an external drawing application on the linked project file
Export the drawing project to a PNG at the embed's path
Configure per-app shell commands with {this.file} and {this.dest} templates
Run create, open, and export in sequence with one Draw (All) command
disambiguation: Not a plugin for drawing inside Obsidian; it shells out to external applications like Krita or MyPaint.
extras: Shell-command knowledge is expected; exporting twice may not refresh the embedded image because Obsidian's file cache cannot be forced to update, requiring reopening the file or re-pasting the link. Flatpak users need Flatseal to grant Obsidian D-Bus session bus access. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian can embed images but has no way to create or edit them in an external drawing application from within a note.

relations.evidence: If you wish to use Krita, you first might need to create a template file
If you want an infinite canvas, you can use MyPaint.
Integrate a draw application into your obsidian workflow, Krita, MyPaint, GIMP, etc.
Install: - MyPaint. - ImageMagick (its for image manipulation).

requires.name: Krita, MyPaint, GIMP, or another drawing application

summary: External drawing-app bridge that creates, opens, and exports drawings from empty image embeds via configurable shell commands.
